snippet.title: Gallery Organizer - Official Announcement Trailer - New Cozy Tidying Game 2026
snippet.description:
Gallery Organizer Official Announcement Trailer New Cozy Sorting Game 2026
We spent months building a cozy sorting game with NO AI art. 
Organizing this messy 1,000-piece art gallery is ever so satisfying.

Take your time with zero-time pressure (or speed run if that’s your thing), unlock and upgrade with helpful tools, choose your favorite relaxing, classical, or upbeat soundtrack, and watch empty walls transform into beautiful, organized exhibitions.

Best of all, every single piece of artwork showcased is from real artists source from royalty-free collections and artists we know, heavily supporting human creators!

If you love sorting games, tidy up simulators, or are hunting for the best new cozy games of 2026 like Unpacking, A Little to the Left, or recent breakout hits like Cat Mail Co and Librarian: Tidy up the Arcane Library, this is the next chill and satisfying game for you.

🎨 Wishlist GALLERY ORGANIZER on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4938790/Gallery_Organizer/
